title: CPSC, Vermont Teddy Bear Co.® and Zany Brainy, Inc.® Announce Recall of Skateboard Keychains Sold With Teddy Bears
summary: The skateboards' wheels can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 15,500.

title: CPSC, L.L. Bean Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Overalls
summary: Snaps on these overalls can detach from the garments, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,700.

title: CPSC, Reckitt & Colman Inc. Announce Recall of EASY-OFF Oven Cleaner
summary: The oven cleaner's contents can spew out because of an improperly attached valve assembly, that can separate from the can. Direct contact with the contents poses a risk of chemical burns to consumers' skin and eyes. Units: About 50,000.

title: CPSC, Nordstrom Inc. Announce Recall of Infant and Girls' Sweatshirts
summary: Zipper pulls on these sweatshirts can detach from the garments, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,300.

title: CPSC, Ariens Co. Announce Recall of Snowblowers
summary: Fuel can leak from the fuel-line connection, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 27,000.

title: In Wake of Second Death, CPSC and Burger King Again Urge Consumers to Destroy and Discard Pokemon Balls
summary: The balls pose a suffocation hazard to children under three years of age. Units: More than 25 million.

title: CPSC, K2 Corp. Announce Recall of In-Line Skates
summary: The skate's plastic brake mount could crack and fail, causing the skater to fall and suffer serious injury. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Announce Recall of Computer Armoires
summary: The upper doors or upper door components can fall off, causing injury to nearby consumers. Units: About 212,400.

title: CPSC, The Sherwin-Williams Co. and Brockway Standard Inc. Announce Recall of Furniture Refinisher
summary: The product and its vapors can seep or leak from the nozzle base at the top of the can, posing a risk of fire and chemical injuries. Units: About 3,000.
